name: polk-county-ingestion-pipeline
description: Script runner for the pipeline: pnpm run <script>

scripts.format: pnpm run format-dbt-sql && pnpm run format-sql && pnpm run format-python && pnpm run format-terraform && pnpm run format-yaml
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint-dbt-sql && pnpm run lint-sql && pnpm run lint-python && pnpm run lint-terraform && pnpm run lint-shell && pnpm run lint-yaml
scripts.docs:serve: pnpm run docs:generate && cd dbt && dbt docs serve
scripts.dbt:check: cd dbt && dbt parse && dbt compile
